intro.text: A people of Scadrial's past whose religion used death chants to free the spirits of the dead. Sazed, a Keeper, knows their prayers.
A people of Scadrial before the Final Empire, known for a culture and religion centred on death and mortality.

description.text: The Cazzi held that death chants release the dead's spirits from their corpses so they can go back to the mountain of souls.
They taught that mortality is beautiful and death important, and that the body plays a vital part in a greater divine whole.

Each body was held to be a work of art made by a spirit living in the world. Those with disabilities of mind or body were said to be punished by that spirit for their wickedness, and a spirit stayed in its body until a death chant freed it.
They kept a caste of slaves, and the Lord Ruler modelled the lives of the skaa on them.
Valuing the body as part of the divine whole, they kept detailed drawings and descriptions of it.

items.text: Sazed recites a Cazzi prayer over the dead of Camon's crew.
Sazed reviews the tenets of the Cazzi faith and rejects them as contradicting themselves.
With the power he took up, Sazed used Cazzi teachings on the body to restore people to the form they had before the Lord Ruler's Ascension.
